defects.reason: Publication gate cannot be executed or content-verified: command_manifest and exact argv for windows-unittest, windows-ruff, wsl-unittest, diff-check, and both owned auditors are explicitly UNRESOLVED placeholders.

defects.evidence: second proposal two_host_manifest.command_source location/sha256=UNRESOLVED; entries_status=UNRESOLVED_PENDING_AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE; ready=false; predicate_classification.convention
defects.reason: Portability/successor two-host manifest is non-executable: authoritative inherited 87-command definition location/sha256 absent; windows_commands.entries empty; every command conservatively Windows-owned by absence, not by predicate review.
No frozen exact candidate/tree/attempt identity; gate self-states publication remains OPEN_MOVING_CANDIDATE and cannot PASS until freeze—reviewing as a closable workflow is premature.

defects.evidence: proposal inputs.adversarial_review_bundle; final-reviews-bound pass_conditions; obligations.model_revision.effective.same_model_independent_review=gpt-5.6-sol xhigh; validation_contract still says Astra; scientific_status.blockers require two fresh independent Sol xhigh approvals
defects.reason: Final review independence obligation is underspecified relative to model-revision-01: 'at least two independent final reviews' plus 'Sol xhigh where same-model required' plus 'adversarial coordinator route' does not hard-bind two fresh gpt-5.6-sol xhigh same-model reviews as the gate's pass condition.

defects.evidence: inputs.receipt_root_windows.resolved=false; clean-cgroup commands UNRESOLVED Windows-side equivalent; failure_behavior.host_unreachable correctly blocks impersonation but does not fix missing Windows attestation mechanism
defects.reason: Dual-host retention and clean-cgroup are incomplete on the Windows side: receipt_root_windows unnamed; Windows quiescence may be marked not-applicable with only a recorded reason—wrong-host/incomplete isolation can be papered over.

defects.evidence: proposal.basis validation_contract_sha256 + model_revision_01_sha256; packet validation_contract.final_reviews/prospective_reviews still say Astra; model_revision.effects require Sol xhigh for later same-model gates
defects.reason: Obligation supersession is not mechanically reconciled: basis hashes both validation_contract (Astra wording) and model_revision_01 (Sol supersession) without a single frozen obligation-binding artifact the gate re-hashes before PASS.

defects.evidence: inputs.quota_observation; ordering list has no explicit quota check id; definitions lack rolling-reserve semantics
defects.reason: quota_observation is a hard gate input (age<=900s, remaining_percent above undefined 8-point rolling reserve, reset_credits_used==0, new_metered_spend==0) without a named observation tool, schema, or binding into check ordering—can force INCOMPLETE/FAIL unrelated to construction evidence or silently weaken if omitted from ordering.

defects.evidence: inputs.activation_source_commit value=235aaa7e...; freeze-and-scope pass_conditions merge-base/path-prefix/no-delete rules
defects.reason: Hardcoded activation_source_commit and path allowlist are untrusted premises that can false-FAIL a legitimate candidate or false-PASS a wrong ancestry if the constant is wrong; packet provides no independent verification.

defects.evidence: proposal.non_goals vs second proposal succession_and_admission; disposition_values includes deferred-owner-bound; pr-body-hash-binding allows construction-only publish after PASS
defects.reason: Treating the two proposals as one workflow lacks an explicit composition/hand-off record: construction PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY must not satisfy scientific successor-gate obligations, but disposition deferred-owner-bound can park scientific blockers while construction proceeds toward non-draft PR.

Deadline feasibility for dual ~4800s Windows scientific gates inside 10200s reserve against 2026-09-11T23:51:42Z is asserted as live pressure, not demonstrated; with candidate still moving, INCOMPLETE_DEADLINE is the expected outcome if scientific succession is bundled into this wave.

defects.evidence: origin_acceptance=false; origin_state='two returned broker-verified proposals; dependent SWE review became unknown'
defects.reason: Broker/origin integrity is weak: origin_acceptance=false and dependent SWE review became unknown—pair cannot be treated as dual independently verified proposals.

defects.evidence: checks.id=preregistration commands UNRESOLVED '...any strict-JSON re-hash of command_manifest suffices'
defects.reason: preregistration weakens tool identity by accepting 'any strict-JSON re-hash of command_manifest' while leaving the validation tool/path unnamed.

defects.evidence: checks.id=source-only-syntax and wsl-lint-or-substitute both allow py_compile over campaign sources
defects.reason: source-only-syntax admits either ast.parse one-liner or py_compile, overlapping wsl-lint substitute—duplicate routes can diverge without a single mandated argv in the missing manifest.

required_checks: Freeze exact PR124 candidate commit+tree; halt further candidate-moving edits; bind gate_attempt_ordinal and preregistered command_manifest sha256 before any check runs.
Populate manifest with exact per-host argv, expected test/skip counts, campaign source sha256s re-derived from frozen candidate, receipt_root_windows, reviewer identities, and PR-body hash fields.
Import authoritative inherited 87-command definition by path+sha256 into two_host_manifest; refuse any reconstructed argv; keep windows_commands.entries empty until that bind exists.

Hard-bind final-reviews-bound to two independent gpt-5.6-sol xhigh reviews (plus any supplemental routes as non-substitutes) of the exact frozen candidate, manifest, gate receipts, audits, and PR body.

Name and require a concrete Windows quiescence/process-exit attestation; disallow windows-side-not-applicable except with an owner-bound recorded deferral that blocks PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY if Windows checks ran.
Emit one frozen obligation-binding record reconciling validation_contract Astra text with model-revision Sol supersession; gate must re-hash that record.
Define quota_observation schema/tool/ordering or remove it from construction pass conditions so metering cannot silently drop or ambiguously block.
Independently verify cited basis/receipt sha256s and open receipt bodies (presence≠contents) before any lead acceptance of the designs as evidence-backed.
Write an explicit composition contract: construction publication-gate PASS vs scientific successor full87+additions+audits+Sol reviews; deferred-owner-bound cannot clear scientific blockers.
Re-run dependent SWE (or equivalent independent) review of both proposals after repairs; retain unknown/fail as blocking until resolved.
reservations: All embedded paths, sha256s, counts, durations, GitHub facts, and status claims are untrusted packet data; this review used no tools and verified none.
Cannot confirm construction-checkpoint-gate-02 PASS, PR121/122 receipt contents, or scientific accounting arithmetic from hashes alone.
Control-to-global-ledger mapping and prospective ceiling overrun remain unsettled; neither proposal may be read as settling them.
Scientific admission remains BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED regardless of construction-gate design quality.
Native WSL results remain partial scientific validation and cannot satisfy unchanged Windows-host/path full-gate predicates.
Deadline arithmetic may make dual Windows scientific gates infeasible even after design repair; feasibility is not established.
origin_acceptance=false and unknown SWE review mean broker-verified dual-proposal status is not established.
strengths: Fail-closed verdict rules explicitly map unrun/timeout/unresolved/host-loss to INCOMPLETE or FAIL, never PASS_CONSTRUCTION_ONLY.
Correctly reconstructs prior internal-receipt acceptance and forbids inventing GitHub status checks/reviews as evidence; claiming them fails pr-body-hash-binding.
Strong anti-forgery stance on host identity, path rewriting, receipt mutation, and native impersonation of full87/Windows receipts.
Clear scientific separation: scientific_approval/accepted false; construction PASS must not be read as admission or 87-gate equivalence.
Candidate-drift re-verification, nonrefundable attempt ordinals, append-only fsynced retention, and no-retry-identity rules match adversarial process needs.
Disposition-completeness forces known negative evidence (moving candidate, missing WSL/full receipts, weak prior PR receipt coverage, wave06 outcomes) to be addressed rather than suppressed.
Honest self-labeling as SOURCE_ONLY / NOT_ADMITTED / NOT_RUN with preserved limitations and explicit non-goals.
review.summary: Both Wave07 designs are carefully fail-closed construction/portability text that correctly refuse GitHub UI evidence and scientific equivalence, but as one workflow they remain non-implementable: frozen candidate, command manifest/argv, Windows retention/quiescence, authoritative 87-command source, and exact Sol xhigh dual-review binding are unresolved, so they need repair before lead acceptance.
